title: Missing language declaration
user_impact: Screen readers read aloud with incorrect pronunciation.

checks.source: WCAG 2.2 SC 3.1.1 Language of Page; ACT b5c3f8 (HTML page has lang attribute); H57; HTML §3.2.6.2 the lang attribute
checks.applicability: The root html element of the top-level document; every HTML page.
checks.expectation:
Fails when the root html element has no lang attribute, or one whose value is
empty or only whitespace: ACT b5c3f8 requires a lang attribute with a
non-empty value, and lang="" explicitly declares the language unknown (HTML
§3.2.6.2), so the page language is not programmatically determinable. xml:lang
alone has no effect in text/html. A non-empty value, valid or not, passes this
id; its validity is document/lang-invalid. A lang set by script before the
audit reads the DOM counts like markup. Embedded documents are html-has-lang.
One finding at the html element.

failing.html:
Page without a lang attribute

The html element above has no lang attribute.
